svg.text: Delegated access: acts as the user
The backend passes the user's identity on, so the source applies that user's own permissions
App-only access: acts as the app
The backend uses its own identity, so the gateway decides who may use the tool
The same agent and the same user can reach data in two different ways · Last updated 2026-11-12
The user signs in through the agent
Checks the token, the agent and the tool
Proves itself to Entra ID with a
Use when people already have access to the data and should never see more than that. Here: the directory profile and spending.
Proves itself to Entra ID with a
Use when people have no direct access to the data and the gateway is the control. Here: the cost centres.
